# Vendored third-party files (served offline; nothing is loaded from a CDN at runtime)

| File | Project | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| maplibre-gl.js, maplibre-gl.css | MapLibre GL JS | 4.7.1 | BSD-3-Clause (see maplibre-LICENSE.txt) |
| pmtiles.js | PMTiles JS (protomaps/PMTiles) | 3.2.1 | BSD-3-Clause |

Downloaded once from `cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/<pkg>@<version>/dist/`. The only edit is removal of the
`sourceMappingURL` comment from maplibre-gl.js.

Map data: (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL; vector tiles from the Protomaps daily build.
